credit_policy.reason: Both ordinal ranges were already logically claimed by earlier workers discovered in post-claim race checks. This receipt preserves only independent cross-check findings.

transfers.claim: In a multi-process cognitive runtime, process-local mutable state must not silently overwrite newer durable shared state; durable state or a single serialized state authority needs freshness/version semantics before mutation.

evidence.finding: Independent E-PQ singletons loaded once; stale core RAM overwrote a newer DB homeostasis reset on the next event. Fix refreshed DB state before every event and capped per-event deltas.

transfers.next_test: Construct two-writer stale-cache replay with versioned durable state; verify stale writer cannot regress a newer state and measure latency cost of refresh/CAS/event-sourcing alternatives.

transfers.claim: Supervisor/process liveness is insufficient for model-service health; runtime supervision should combine process state with application/protocol health and bounded consecutive-failure recovery.

evidence.finding: llama-server could remain systemd-active while HTTP-unresponsive; /health checks with a consecutive-failure threshold were added before forced restart.
Genesis sensors could block long enough to starve watchdog petting, causing repeated daemon restart loops.

transfers.next_test: Fault-inject hung-but-alive model server, slow sensor and half-open HTTP states; measure detection delay, false positives and recovery completeness.

transfers.claim: When a derived cognitive visualization/state is consumed by multiple surfaces, one authoritative headless producer with streamed/proxied views avoids divergent duplicate simulations.

evidence.finding: Overlay was changed to proxy the real headless AURA grid from port 8098 instead of running its own local GoL state.

transfers.next_test: Run two consumers with packet delay/reconnect and assert identical generation/hash trajectories against the producer; test replay and snapshot recovery.

transfers.claim: Persistent cognition benefits from a bounded hot working set plus append-preserving archival history rather than treating a ring buffer as durable memory.

evidence.finding: Permanent archive tables and dual-write were introduced while retaining larger recent ring-style caches.

transfers.next_test: Compare ring-only, archive-plus-hot-cache and event-log-plus-materialized-view designs on recall completeness, retrieval latency, write amplification and crash recovery.

transfers.claim: Autonomous self-improvement loops need evidence-bearing proposals, deduplication, noise suppression, diversity pressure and real selection pressure; unconstrained positive feedback can produce monoculture, saturation or huge activity with zero useful crystallization.

evidence.finding: Genesis was reported as a no-selection 'paradise' with saturated emotions, massive energy and no useful proposals; caps, senescence and culling were introduced.
Historical log replay generated duplicate organisms; persistent dedup and quality gates were added.
Metadata loss blocked quality gating and a dominant approach created monoculture; metadata inheritance and monoculture penalties were added.
Unfiltered warnings and removed-code logs became bogus fix proposals; multi-level noise filters were added.

transfers.measurement_boundary: Commit messages contain historical test/result numbers; those figures were not independently reproduced in this cross-check and are not promoted as current runtime measurements.
transfers.next_test: Preregister mutation/fusion/selection ablations with usefulness, diversity, duplicate rate, evidence completeness and false-proposal rate as separate outcomes.

transfers.claim: Always-available introspective telemetry can dominate generated cognition unless salience is controlled; selective/slim context, event thresholds, alternation and repetition guards are concrete anti-fixation mechanisms.

evidence.finding: Slim proprioception, AURA/idle alternation and recent-topic repetition guards were introduced to reduce fixation.
Perceptual hardware-event thresholds were raised and introspective prompts grounded in actual measurements.
Consciousness prompt tuning explicitly reduced routine temperature fixation while retaining proprioception as background awareness.

transfers.next_test: Randomize telemetry density/salience and measure topic entropy, task relevance, sensor mention rate and recovery after telemetry spikes.

transfers.claim: Observable functional integration, persistent state and behaviorally consequential telemetry must remain epistemically separate from claims of phenomenal experience or unverified novelty.

evidence.finding: README language was explicitly corrected from direct feeling/consciousness claims to functional observations with subjective experience left open.
Historical novelty/no-precedent claims were documented but are source assertions here, not independently verified by this cross-check.
AURA interpretation was prompt-driven from real zone data; this supports an introspection mechanism, not a phenomenal-consciousness inference.

transfers.next_test: Maintain separate claim classes for measured functional behavior, mechanistic interpretation, novelty search and phenomenal hypotheses; forbid promotion across classes without new evidence.

negative_results_preserved: Stale per-process E-PQ state overwrote newer persisted state.
systemd active did not guarantee HTTP-serving model health.
Watchdog petting could be starved by blocking sensors.
Historical log replay created duplicate autonomous-improvement organisms.
Missing inherited proposal metadata blocked quality-gate passage.
Unfiltered warning/log noise became false fix proposals.
Weak selection pressure produced saturated/high-activity dynamics without useful output.
Startup timestamp initialization could indefinitely block a reflection queue.
Hardcoded host paths accumulated broadly enough to require centralized path resolution.
